pretreatments.description: Biological pretreatment, based on the joint action of the native microbiota of Agave bagasse composed mainly of Clostridium, Lactobacillus, and Enterobacter, described as a core microbiome of lignocellulosic biomasses, which primarily hydrolyzed xylan, converting it into volatile fatty acids simulated solely as acetic acid to simplify the study.

Enzymatic pretreatment, based on the action of the commercial enzyme cocktail Cellulase 50XL, simulated to a dose of 293 endoglucanase units (EGU)/g of bagasse working in a 50 mM citrate buffer pH 6, which released mainly glucose along with galactose, arabinose, and other sugars.
Dilute acid pretreatment, solubilized all xylan and partially cellulose in 1.8 % HCl under soft operating conditions, which recovered sugars and eliminated the generation of inhibitors.
Steam explosion pretreatment, solubilized xylan producing a mixture of sugars and acetic acid, with low concentrations of furfural (0.7 g/L) and hydroxymethylfurfural (0.12 g/L).
